Name: Stacy
Dialog: (from inside) Futons, bouillon, platypus food... (Cut to her, looking in a pantry.) Ooh! Microwave popcorn! Need this.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And I have sodas. What else do we wanna bring over your house?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Doesn't matter. I doubt we'll not be able to eat while we're watching this movie.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The Grievance. So scary no one over the age 45 will even watch it!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It will be even scarier 'cause my family's out for the day and we will be alone at the house.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, are you sure you can handle this? (They go out to the backyard.) It took me four days to pry you out from under the bed last time we saw a scary movie. (outside) What? What are you looking at? Oh no.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb! What are you guys up to?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's a surprise for Isabella's birthday!

Name: Candace
Dialog: A surprise...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Here we go again.

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...for Isabella's...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Give me those sodas. (She grabs the sodas Candace was holding)

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...Birthday.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: See ya. (She walks off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Building supplies? Check. Guest list? Check. Perry? Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Still leaving) Yeah, where does that platypus go everyday?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P.? (The lights flicker on) Ah, there you are. What do you think of the new motion sensor lights we've installed in your lair. (The lights go off again) Um... Agent P. try flailing your arms about that should- (Agent P. does so and the lights turn on) There we go! Now, Doofenshmirtz has been driving around town in some sort of truck that turns inanimate objects, like parking meters, into bugs. Eww. I want you to-- (The lights go off in where Major Monogram is) Really? Carl, I'm waiving my arms, why aren't the lights coming back on?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's not funny, Carl.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, time to commence operation INAP.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: (To Candace) That stands for Isabella's Natal Anniversary Party.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know what INAP means. Just get to the dangerous part I'm readying the phone.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay everyone, we need to carry all this stuff over to Isabella's backyard, so we can set it up for--

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Phineas. What'cha doooin'? You're not planning something for my birthday, are you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't look, don't look, don't look! Nothing to see here.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas! But all I really want for my birthday is-

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't ruin the surprise! (He laughs nervously) Buford, get her out of here.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You got it. (He throws a bag over Isabella and carries her out)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But what I real-

Name: Buford
Dialog: I've carried a lot of squirmin' bags in my time, but this is the first time I knew who was in it. (He walks off)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Augh! What I was going to say was all I want for my birthday is some alone time with-- (motions to Phineas) Never mind. (She walks out)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You wanted to be alone with this bag?

Name: Phineas and kids
Dialog: Happy birthday, Isabella!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the platypus? It's no use trying to break through my protective bubble. It's platyproof-poof. I mean, oh you know what I mean. Anyway, you're probably wondering what I'm doing, driving this evil bug bus around town. I just got to thinking about all the things that bug me. Portable outhouses, high voltage signs. "Danger High Voltage". I'll decide how much voltage I can take! That's why I created the Bugs-me-inator. It turns whatever bugs me into bugs. And, since I can't stand bugs, I'm protected from them inside this bubble. (Perry points to a bug inside Doofenshmirtz's bubble) Huh? Oh, that's on the outs-- Ow! Get it off! Get it off! Get it off! Get it off! (Doofenshmirtz open the bubble to let the bugs out) Wait I'm not ready! (Perry punches him, causing him to spin around his bubble) Whoa, whoa whoa. Right to the point huh? You know Perry the Platypus, more than anything, you bug me. (He fires the -inator at Perry, who dodges it, making the beam, instead, hit one of Doofenshmirtz's shoes) Ah! My shoe! Ow Get off! Get off! Get off! Ow! (Doofenshmirtz launches himself at Perry, but Perry redirects him back into his bubble, spinning him again.) Whoa. Whoa. Whoa. Boy I really got to rethink the design on this think. By the way, you know we're on a runaway bus careening at high speed with no one at the wheel, right?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (To the movie) Don't go in there. Don't go in there. Don't go in there. Don't go in there. You went in there. Oh, gross she brought thousands of tiny bugs into the house. What could be worse than that? (Doofenshmirtz's bus crashes into Stacy's house) Big bug! Ahhh! (Stacy hides behind the couch) OMG! Perry! What are you doing here?! And why are you wearing a hat? Look out! (Doofenshmirtz flies onto the couch) And who's this pharmacist?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Really? Really? W-why does everyone just stampede to that conclusion? Other people wear lab coats you know. Why, why don't you say, "Oh look a rocket scientist." Or a veterinarian?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Are you a veterinarian?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No... But that's not the point.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Check it out. (Isabella's massive cake is seen being wheeled in.) We made your favorite, a red velvet cake, with a little surprise.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ooh, I hope they do not have a male dancer popping out of it.

Name: Buford
Dialog: They asked, but they couldn't afford me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Will you do the honors Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (To Isabella) Make a wish.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (In her thoughts) I wish for time alone with Phineas.

Name: Holly
Dialog: (To Candace) What are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Waiting for things to get dangerous, so I can my mom to come bust the boys.

Name: Holly
Dialog: That's not dangerous?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dude, this is nothing, it'll get worse.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, did you get what you wished for?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh-

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, it's every girls wish to have her backyard covered in litter. Let's go you two. Next event.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're gonna love this.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Is this where you go everyday Perry?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (While fighting Perry) Oh yeah, pretty much. I create -inators, and he breaks in and thwarts my scheme, and it's, it's kinda our thing. (Perry knocks Doofenshmirtz to the ground) Ooh! The Grievance! I saw this in theaters. I still have nightmares about the greasy little girl who comes out of the base--

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Still behind the couch) No! Don't tell me how it ends!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And, now, what's a birthday party without a piñata the size of your house? Ferb? Hit it. (Ferb breaks the giant piñata with a giant bat, releasing smaller ones for everyone else to hit.)

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Woohoo!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: I'm gonna bat with this stick.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Give up the candy, yo!

Name: Holly
Dialog: (Still speaking with Candace) This isn't dangerous enough?

Name: Candace
Dialog: We're getting there.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Isabella, this must be your best birthday ever.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (A little sadly) Yeah, sure. It's super cool. I didn't need--

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay Birthday girl, onto the next. (He trows a bag over her, and deposits her at her pool)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Gather 'round everyone, and keep your eyes on the pool. Isabella, it's grand finale time! (He pulls a lever, and the pool begins to shake.)

Name: Holly
Dialog: Um? This might be the time to call.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yep! (She dials Linda) Mom? You've got to come across the street immediately.

Name: Kids
Dialog: Ooh!

Name: Milly
Dialog: What a grand, and glorious, and potentially bustable gift!

Name: Adyson
Dialog: I've never seen anything like it!

Name: Linda
Dialog: That key? That key?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Here, grab these will ya?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, you've got to see what the boys are doing in Isabella's yard!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Isabella's yard? That's a new one.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Alright, look. You're getting oil all over the place. Someone's going to have to-- (Stacy trips, and falls in the pool of oil.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! It's the greasy Grievance girl from the basement! No! No! What have I done? Why do you have a grievance against me? (Doofenshmirtz screams, and jumps out the window)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Fixing her hair) Whoa. What was that all about? Do the Flynn Fletchers know you fight evil scientists? (Stacy accidentally steps on the remote firing the -inator, and Perry whacks it with a bat, destroying it. The -inator beam bounces off a satellite and heads back towards Earth)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Back here, Mom.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Butterflies? I love butterflies! Oh, thank you Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Confused at how the gift turned to butterflies) What?

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but, but, but, but... Butterflies?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, how beautiful. How long did it take you guys to collect them all?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Let's go boys, looks like we've got some cleaning up to do. Alright you and you begin with the pavement area around here. And you... (Monogram rings the doorbell) Danville Water and Power. We're here to read your gas thingy.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Perry? What is all this? (Perry hands Stacy a pamphlet) A-a host family, mind erasing, balloon coverup? I mean is all this really necessary? (Perry shrugs) Wait a minute! It says right here in your silly little pamphlet that if your host family finds out about your agent status, then anyone who's seen you has to have their memory erased, or you'll get relocated. Perry, I'm not part of your host family!  I know, I know, it's a technicality. Look, I don't want Candace and the boys to lose you, but I also do not want my mind erased. I'm on the last ten minutes of that Grievance movie, and I don't want to have to watch that whole scary mess again. So, uh, can we just keep this a secret? (Perry smiles and tips his hat to Stacy)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Luckily Sir, it looks like the residents were not home.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (At the front door) Hello? Uh, anybody there?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (To Carl) I'll take care of it. (To Stacy) Oh, hello there young teenager. You live here?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yes. I walked home from the mall to find... this. What is happening here?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, you didn't see what happened? Well, um. We're with the city, and there was a swamp gas incident here. We'll just get it all cleaned up, and get out of your hair. (He turns to Carl) Psst. Hey Carl. We're not going to need the mind erasing device. (He looks back at Stacy) I mean monkey wrench. Hehe. Monkey wrench, we don't need that.

Name: Katie
Dialog: Happy birthday, Isabella!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thanks guys!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I still can't figure out what went wrong with the grand finale. After the laser light show, and the fireballs, the swans should have been released, and-

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, I really liked the butterflies. Thank you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well to make it up to you, it's kinda lame but... maybe Ferb and I could, I don't know, take you out for some ice cream or something?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh-

Name: Ferb
Dialog: I...just remembered there's...something I need to do. You two go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is that cool?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yes! Very cool. Ferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, did you get what you wished for? Oh, yeah, I already asked that. Confetti, and streamers. Hold on, gonna get another napkin. (He goes off)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (romantically) And butterflies, you always give me butterflies.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (From her window) Ah, look at them out there. What are they up to? Ah, it looks like Phineas is saying "Where's Perry?" Huh. Where do you think Perry goes everyday Stace?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Quickly and nervously) How should I know!? Why are you asking me!? How should I know!? Don't look at me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She stares at Stacy for a moment) Nah, I don't know why I was asking you.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (In her head) Whew, no one suspects a thing.
